## Names
- We Sail Where the Puddles Flow (Construct · Society / Tradition) · via characters · undated
  The Puddle Navy's motto, and Admiral Fluffington's catchphrase. Moppets say it at launches and at funerals, in the same voice.

## Sheet
- Puddleton (Location · Settlement / City) · via birthplace · known of
  Two lines
  and a trailing break
  
- Feltropolis 🦆 (Location · Settlement / Station) · via location · known of
  Orbital space station and primary manufacturing hub for felt technology: a spindle of seven levels, from The Docks at the bottom to The Spire at the top.
- Moppet (Species · People / Parent Species) · via species · known of
  The people of Moppetopia: small felt creatures with googly eyes, who eat by absorbing moisture. Puddle Moppets, Dust Moppets, Space Moppets and Feral Moppets are its kinds.
- Puddle Moppet (Species · People / Variant) · via species · known of
  The standard moppet subtype. Water-absorbing, traditional, mostly found in Puddleton.
- Captain Snoot (Character · Fringe / Smuggler) · via rivals · known of
  Rogue explorer, smuggler, and the one who knows. Faded blue felt, one googly eye missing since the Snack Nebula crash; under the eyepatch there may be the Googly Eye of Truth. He left the Puddle Navy after The Incident (Year 120 YSL) with evidence of the Moistened Valley Massacre cover-up, and has kept it hidden ever since. He drinks at The Soggy Sock, trades with the Cookie Pirates, and buys information from Madame Threadbare at The Thread Market, playing both sides. In Year 203 YSL he found The Rolling Pin past the Crumblefields, a humming Bakerfolk ruin three kilometers long, and brought back a fragment that hums in time with the Eternal Drip's pump cycle.
